requirement: Intended use and unit of observation are explicit
Every variable has an approved definition and storage type
Measurement units and conversions agree with indicator definitions
required_inputs: Signed unit definitions and transformation review

requirement: Rule set and dictionary versions are identifiable
Every tolerance has a rationale and owner
Database constraints are semantically equivalent to dictionary requirements
interpretation_or_threshold: Exact business meaning, not text similarity

requirement: Reference tables have declared versions available to the run
Master reference keys are complete and unique
Child keys match the approved reference
Scattered hardcoded lookup values receive review
Filename matches the approved project-period-dataset convention
Original file is available and readable
Original file has an identifiable checksum
File and decompressed archive stay within inspection budgets
CSV record widths and headers are structurally valid
Unsupported or encrypted file formats require a suitable reader
interpretation_or_threshold: No silent pass for unsupported files

requirement: No empty observation rows or internal worksheet gaps
Summary labels are not mixed with observations
required_inputs: Approved list of prohibited row labels

requirement: Keys reflect the intended observation grain
Expected volume or minimum nonempty dataset exists
No undeclared additional columns
Column names are populated and unique before repair
Names follow approved syntax and are interpretable
required_inputs: Column naming expression and dictionary review

requirement: Data worksheets do not contain unapproved merged cells
Hidden observation rows are identified
Hidden columns are identified
Hidden and very-hidden worksheets are identified
Saved active filters are distinguished from filter arrows
Formula cells and stale-cache risk receive review
Spreadsheet error cells are identified
External links and macro parts receive review
interpretation_or_threshold: Never execute or fetch during audit

requirement: Critical fields are complete
Optional fields exceeding approved missingness rates are flagged
Missingness denominators exclude genuinely inapplicable records
interpretation_or_threshold: Unknown applicability is not excluded silently

requirement: Undeclared blank and sentinel coding is identified
interpretation_or_threshold: Zero, minus one and 999 are not globally invalid

requirement: Missingness is compared by region, collector, round or source
interpretation_or_threshold: Patterns do not identify missingness mechanism

requirement: Stored classes match dictionary types
Values satisfy domain-approved bounds
interpretation_or_threshold: Do not hardcode universal clinical cutoffs

requirement: Unintended Inf and NaN values are identified
Counts are integer-valued within declared tolerance
Categories match exact approved options
Identifiers match approved formatting
Text has no unexplained leading or trailing spaces
List or mixed-content columns receive explicit schema decisions
interpretation_or_threshold: List class alone does not validate each nested element

requirement: A recorded treatment or status requires its dependent date
Skipped questions remain empty when required by the form
Mutually exclusive selections are not jointly selected
interpretation_or_threshold: At most one or exactly one

requirement: Multi-select encoding uses legal unique options
Interdependent values or dates satisfy declared order
Components reconcile to their total
Numerators and denominators produce valid ratios
Repeated values respect declared temporal order
required_inputs: Entity groups and unambiguous order variable

requirement: Unique observation keys are present
All members of unexpected duplicate groups are reported
Entirely repeated records are identified
Probabilistic entity matches require adjudication
Expected one-to-one or many-to-one joins cannot silently multiply rows
interpretation_or_threshold: Compose checks before and after joins

requirement: Unmatched source rows and missing reference coverage are measured
Independent source totals agree by reporting group
required_inputs: Trusted reference and exact aggregation definitions

requirement: Event and submission timestamps are available
Events occurred inside the approved collection window
Event-to-ingestion lag is measurable and acceptable
Dates are not implausibly future-dated
Latest received data are not stale
interpretation_or_threshold: Does not establish every partition is present

requirement: Expected rounds or dates have not disappeared
Collector IDs are complete and match approved rosters
Implausibly short interviews are reviewed
Overlapping interviews by a collector are reviewed
Repeated submission timestamps are reviewed
interpretation_or_threshold: Batch submission alone is not misconduct

requirement: Identical response patterns receive review
required_inputs: Selected response fields and interview context

requirement: Independent backchecks verify collection and selected responses
interpretation_or_threshold: No fabricated confidence from paradata alone

requirement: Coordinates are numeric and within geographical bounds
Recorded point is within approved distance of reference point
interpretation_or_threshold: Spherical distance; GPS precision requires interpretation

requirement: Coordinates agree with approved polygon boundaries
Facility, district and province combinations match official mapping
Coverage gaps by region or stratum are identified
interpretation_or_threshold: Coverage is not proof of representativeness

requirement: Key-variable distributions and nonfinite values are summarized
Comparable-period distributions are checked for change
required_inputs: Comparable baseline and optional KS/TV thresholds
interpretation_or_threshold: Descriptive effect sizes; not causation or fraud detection

requirement: Extreme but plausible values are reviewed, not erased
Digit patterns and other anomaly scores need independent evidence
Required scripts are tracked and match expected commit
interpretation_or_threshold: Clean commit history is not semantic correctness

requirement: Added, removed and retyped fields are visible
interpretation_or_threshold: Key type changes require explicit migration

requirement: Changed cells and inserted/deleted records have exact change IDs
interpretation_or_threshold: Hashes do not authenticate the editor

requirement: Change documentation matches the exact changed content
required_inputs: Approval ID, URI, hash and reviewer

requirement: Retries do not duplicate database routing receipts
required_inputs: Transactional database and unique run receipt
interpretation_or_threshold: Duplicate run is rejected, not silently replayed

requirement: R, package and system dependencies are reproducible
interpretation_or_threshold: No fabricated lockfile from an unexecuted environment

requirement: Runtime failures and warnings cannot produce a pass
Checks run at the required lifecycle trigger
interpretation_or_threshold: A trigger label is not evidence of deployment

requirement: Violating records are separated without silent data repair
Breached critical gates hold otherwise valid rows where required
Accepted/quarantine/held writes share one transaction
interpretation_or_threshold: Backend must be qualified; no nested transactions

requirement: Breaches identify dataset, rule, row and responsible owner
interpretation_or_threshold: No ticket is claimed until delivery confirmed

requirement: Resource limits cannot silently turn a census into a sample
interpretation_or_threshold: Current engine is local and in-memory

requirement: Findings create persistent issue identities and events
interpretation_or_threshold: Stable keyed HMAC identities needed across snapshots

requirement: Incident status changes follow permitted transitions
Resolution records the actual cause and upstream correction
Closure requires fresh validation under unchanged requirements
required_inputs: New dq_result for same entity and rule set
interpretation_or_threshold: Deletion or weakened thresholds are not correction

requirement: Closure and dispositions require independent approval
interpretation_or_threshold: Names are not authenticated by the package

requirement: Waivers require reasons, evidence and expiry
interpretation_or_threshold: Waivers do not override release gates

requirement: Closed duration and still-open backlog ages are both reported
interpretation_or_threshold: Closed-case median is not a censored survival estimate

requirement: History modification and expected-head conflicts are detected
required_inputs: Externally retained head and append-only permissions
interpretation_or_threshold: Hash chain is not a digital signature or administrator-proof storage

requirement: Least privilege and authorized access are independently evidenced
interpretation_or_threshold: File readability does not establish authorization

requirement: Quarantined raw data use protected storage and retention controls
required_inputs: Database roles, encryption and retention rules
interpretation_or_threshold: Package does not provision authentication or encryption

requirement: Consent and approved processing purpose are established
interpretation_or_threshold: A consent column alone is not legal verification

requirement: Reports suppress raw data values and escape active content
interpretation_or_threshold: Pseudonymous IDs and source text may still be sensitive

requirement: Stable-identity secrets are protected and rotation is managed
interpretation_or_threshold: Hashes and HMAC identifiers are not anonymization

requirement: Values are corroborated against trusted independent sources
interpretation_or_threshold: Internal consistency does not establish truth

requirement: Images and documents have provenance and contextual verification
required_inputs: Original media, capture context and reviewer evidence
interpretation_or_threshold: EXIF or a checksum alone does not prove time/place or content authenticity

requirement: Control evidence is current, complete and independently reviewed
required_inputs: Evidence metadata and optional local hash verification
interpretation_or_threshold: Remote content is not fetched or authenticated
